Attack on Burgos (14) from Madrid:
Troops: 1 spearman, 3 archer, 1 knight.
Attack values: spearman 1, archer 2 each (6), knight 4 (4). Total = 11.
Most numerous: archer (3). Enemy (Burgos) has 2 spearmen, most numerous spearman. Archer counters spearman, so we get 1.5x multiplier.
Effective attack = 11 * 1.5 = 16.5.
Burgos effective defense = 5.
16.5 > 5, so victory. We lose troops worth half of Burgos's effective force (5/2=2.5). So we lose a small number.

Attack on Valencia (16) from Murcia:
Troops: 2 archer, 1 knight.
Attack: 2*2 + 4 = 8.
Most numerous: archer (2). Enemy has 2 spearmen, 2 knights; most numerous tie: spearman wins. So enemy most numerous spearman. Archer counters spearman, so 1.5x.
Effective attack = 8 * 1.5 = 12.
Valencia defense = 10.
12 > 10, victory. Losses: half of 10 = 5.

Attack on Vigo (10) from Porto:
Troops: 2 archer, 2 knight.
Attack: 2*2 + 2*4 = 4+8=12.
Most numerous: archer and knight tie (2 each). Tie breaks in order spearman, archer, knight. So archer is most numerous. Enemy (Vigo) has 3 spearmen, 3 knights; tie, spearman wins. So enemy most numerous spearman. Archer counters spearman, so 1.5x.
Effective attack = 12 * 1.5 = 18.
Vigo defense = 15.
18 > 15, victory. Losses: half of 15 = 7.5.

All attacks should succeed.
